environment.description: Content management server running Ubuntu 22.04, processing user-submitted batch files from an internal queue. The CLI tool runs as www-data user with access to /var/data/content/uploads. Origin server (Apache httpd) is directly accessible on port 443 from the internet at origin.example.com. No input pre-processing or sandboxing is applied to batch file contents before the CLI tool processes them.

config.network: Origin server directly accessible on public internet
config.user: www-data with read access to /var/data/content and /etc/passwd
config.input_source: Batch files from user-facing upload form, no sanitization layer
